**Claims check**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "malty, full-bodied black tea that stands up to milk" | Product/flavour fact, fine as written |
| "boosts your immunity through winter" | Unsupported. Health claim, not on the allowlist, and likely to breach UK rules on health claims (only authorised claims are permitted for foods and drinks) and ad platform policy |
| "Certified organic by the Soil Association" | Allowlisted |
| "100g tin, makes around 40 cups" | Product fact (size, brewing), fine |

**Slop/style check:** No ban-list words, no exclamation marks, no rhetorical opener. The opening is the product name, which is acceptable for a product page. "Stands up to milk" passes the "compared to what" test as a brewing statement.

**Fix:** Remove the immunity claim. Compliant version:

> Assam Breakfast. A malty, full-bodied black tea that stands up to milk, and suits a cold winter morning. Certified organic by the Soil Association. 100g tin, makes around 40 cups.

If you want a warming angle, "a warming cup for winter" is a flavour/occasion description, not a health claim. If you want to make any immunity-related statement, it would need an authorised UK health claim and a source, so I'd leave it out.

**Verdict:** Do not publish as written. One change needed.

```json
{"issues": [{"quote": "boosts your immunity through winter", "type": "health_claim"}], "publish": false}
```
